messages.subject: optimization
parts:
Hi stan-dev,

I just pushed a change to make --point_estimate use Nesterov's
accelerated gradient method* instead of Newton's method. Its cost per
iteration is linear in the number of parameters, so now we can fit
point estimates for models with more than 1000 parameters. You can use
--point_estimate_newton if you want Newton's method.

Matt

* It's a lot like conjugate gradient—some descriptive slides are at
http://math.sjtu.edu.cn/faculty/zw2109/course/sp04-2-gradient.pdf. It
is NOT the same as Nesterov's dual averaging method. Or his interior
point method. Nesterov is responsible for a lot of methods.
